name: The Stone household at 2035 Prairie Avenue
head: pa1904_stone_mrs_h_o

present_on_scene_date.note: Listed at 2035 Prairie Avenue in the Blue Book for 1904 (canvass begun September 1903) and again in the 1905 edition (canvass begun September 1904), which bracket 1 July 1904. The 1905 list prints: 2035 Mrs. H. O. Stone.

associated_with.note: The Blue Book's Prairie Avenue street list prints the household at 2035, and the 1905 list again. The book gives no date the household came or went, so neither end is dated here.

not_in_this_household.note: WHO IS NOT ON THIS CARD, AND WHY. The Blue Book is a society register: it names the family members who received and were received, prints unmarried daughters only as '& dr.', and names no young children, servants, coachmen, cooks or nurses. The 1900 census (ED 40, T623 roll 245) was read for this card. The four live-in staff it lists at the house on 1 June 1900 are on the card, graded inferred because the count was taken four years before the scene. Left off: Robert Stone (a married son the 1904 Blue Book does not list at the house); Ada E. Stone (his wife; not listed in 1904 either). The 1910 census was not read. A person goes on this card when a source names them, and not before.

persons.name: Mrs. H. O. Stone
persons.note: The 1900 census lists H. O. Stone here as head, born October 1845 (the figures are hard to read), in New York, widowed (ED 40, sheet 12B, line 84, leaf n817).

persons.name: Alice Green

born.note: The census gives March 1850, age 50 on 1 June 1900.

occupation.note: Written as "Housekeeper" in the occupation column on 1 June 1900.

persons.note: Enumerated on 1 June 1900 in the house, as a servant (housekeeper); born March 1850, in Ireland, single. Servants changed places often, so this records who worked here in 1900; no source read says whether this person was still here on 1 July 1904. Part of the name is hard to read on the sheet; this is the best reading.
